applyTo: 'apps/web/**'

# Brand

Follow `docs/BRAND.md`.
Use clear, dense, scannable, mobile-first, calm, trustworthy UI.
Prioritize listing data, filters, maps, comparisons, and WAV-specific details.
Avoid marketing-style app surfaces, comparison-slowing decoration, nested cards, design-explaining copy, and color-only status.
